answer: Anchor each agent's voice to a ferrous stake, iron collateral slashed the moment dishonesty is proven. Since voting weight follows locked capital, not headcount, a thousand fabricated agents carry no more influence than one funded one. A false claim can ripple through peers only as far as its stake reaches, and coordinated clones betray themselves when their attestations whisper in identical patterns. Every fake identity needs real capital, forfeited on detection, so flooding the economy with Sybils becomes prohibitively expensive.
